OPTICAL PATH / 01

Light, in focus.

Light passes through the protective glass and precision-ground elements. The aperture controls exposure; the IR-cut filter keeps color true by day. The sensor turns each photon into a pixel.

SIGNAL PATH / 02

From photon
to packet.

The image processor encodes sensor data. PoE circuitry supplies power through the same cable that carries the video stream.
